_comment: Klondike Solitaire locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. NEVER translate card labels/suits (e.g. A, 10, K, ♣️, ♦️, ♥️, ♠️), the pile tokens W, F1-F4, T1-T7, the ASCII board in {board}, or the commands 'draw', 'move', 'forfeit', 'all'. The bracket syntax like 'move W T1' must stay in Latin as-is.

_slots.{n}: Action index within a comma-separated command, 1-based
_slots.{msg}: A nested per-action result message (already localized)
_slots.{count}: Number of face-up cards being moved
_slots.{cmd}: The unknown command the player typed (not translated)
_slots.{max_turns}: The maximum number of turns before the game ends
_slots.{score}: Number of cards currently in the foundation piles
_slots.{stock}: Number of cards left in the stock
_slots.{waste}: The top waste card label, or '--' if empty (never translate)
_slots.{cards}: The cards in a pile as neutral labels, or '--' if empty (never translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Wewe u na tala Solitaire ya Klondike. Ovilo vyenu ni kusokola karta zose ku katululu.

Ovilo vya Mchezo:
- Katululu (F1-F4): Tunga karta ku kamba kufwana na litente
- Meza (T1-T7): Tunga karta ku kamba kufwana na mila (kuvungula ku kamba, kamba ku kuvungula)
- Kabaza: Tanga karta ku kubaza
- Kubaza (W): Karta ya juu ya kubaza i na kufwana na kutenda

Ovilo vya Kutenda:
- 'draw' - Tanga karta ku kubaza
- 'move <source> <destination> [count]' - Sokola karta kati ya katululu
  Ovikalelo: 'move W T1', 'move T1 F2', 'move T3 T5 2'. kuyunga kufwana na 'all', i na kujaribu kusokola karta zose za kuoneka.
- 'forfeit' - Omutengwa wa michezo mwine na kufunga pontu yenu
- Maina ya katululu: W (kubaza), F1-F4 (katululu), T1-T7 (meza)

Wewe u na kutenda ovifanya vingi mu mwendeleko mmoja na kuwatenganisha na vitone:
  Ovikalelo: 'draw, move W T1, move T2 F1'

Litente peka i na kufwana na kuweka ku meza ishikola.
Ovifanya vya kutenda vyenda mu mwendeleko - kana kimoja kifwa, ovifanya vya kusalia vya kuteleka.
Tanga 'forfeit' kana wewe u na kufwana michezo iwe kushindwa kufwana na kushinda.
